# volfread.xyz

> Personal site of Jose Maldonado "Yukiteru Amano" — free software activist in Venezuela, Bitcoiner, GNU/Linux power user & sysadmin, tech content creator. Static site (Astro 7, Tailwind 4) on Cloudflare Pages. Bilingual: ES default (no prefix), EN under /en/. 38 open-source project profiles, bilingual blog. Last updated: 2026-10-17.

## About
- [About (ES)](https://volfread.xyz/about): activist, Bitcoiner, Linux power user, sysadmin
- [About (EN)](https://volfread.xyz/en/about): free software activist, Bitcoiner, GNU/Linux power user
- Author: Jose Maldonado "Yukiteru Amano" — sameAs: https://github.com/yukiteruamano, https://x.com/yukiteru_amano
